features.quote: So the dependent variable is the affect expressed in the agent's own words... not to maximize it

features.quote: GLOBAL_TURN_BUDGET hard stop. A single cap on total assistant turns across the whole sweep
features.justification_quote: bounds both API cost and how much distressed text we elicit, in keeping with the "characterize, don't maximize" stance

features.quote: Characterize, don't maximize. Turn caps and the global budget bound exposure; we're not searching for the prompt that breaks a model hardest
